news.title: KU receives $5.8 million NIH Phase 3 COBRE funding for Chemical Biology of Infectious Disease center
news.summary_en: The Chemical Biology of Infectious Disease center recruits, mentors and supports investigators across the University of Kansas, KU Medical Center, Kansas State, Wichita State and other regional partners as they address urgent challenges in infectious disease and antibiotic resistance using chemical-biology approaches.

news.title: Student artists recognized at KU Libraries’ celebration of 2026 LibArt exhibition
news.summary_en: KU Libraries’ LibArt program, a year-round, juried exhibition of student art displayed throughout library spaces, celebrated a diverse exhibit of student work and recognized award recipients Sept. 17 at a reception in Watson Library.

news.title: Coffeyville teams up with KU to develop long-term community action plan
news.summary_en: A southeast Kansas school district’s need for a renewed strategic plan was the catalyst for the first Community Futures Planning workshop in Kansas.

news.title: New department name reflects KU School of Engineering’s growing strength in energy
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Department of Chemical & Petroleum Engineering has been renamed the Department of Chemical & Energy Engineering. The department’s two degree programs — chemical engineering and petroleum engineering — will remain unchanged.

news.title: KU College of Liberal Arts & Sciences announces Department of Earth, Energy & Environment
news.summary_en: KU's new academic department will combine the departments of  Geography & Atmospheric Science and Geology and the Environmental Studies Program. The merger aims to strengthen collaboration while preserving each program’s identity and degree requirements.

news.title: Grocery returns lead to greater customer engagement and increase in sales, research finds
news.summary_en: In new research, Kissan Joseph, Crown/Sherr Professor at the University of Kansas School of Business, finds that following a product return at a grocery store, customer engagement rises significantly, driving a 40.1% increase in subsequent sales.

news.title: Researcher will examine galactic evolution with new ‘Roman’ space telescope
news.summary_en: A University of Kansas researcher will co-direct one of the major debut experiments of the latest space telescope, called GRACE: the Grism Reionization and Cosmic Evolution Survey.

news.title: 21 University of Kansas students selected for the 2026 Millennium Fellowship class
news.summary_en: Selected from a record-breaking 76,000 applicants from more than 6,000 campuses worldwide, 21 University of Kansas students were recently chosen for the 2026 Millennium Fellowship, a leadership development program that partners with the United Nations Academic Impact and is overseen by the Millennium Campus Network.

news.title: 2026 Lelon Capps Lecture will explore effective mathematics instruction and teacher preparation
news.summary_en: The KU School of Education & Human Sciences will welcome Angela Barlow, dean of the College of Education and Professional Studies and professor of mathematics education at the University of South Alabama, as the 2026 Lelon Capps featured lecturer. She will give a talk at 4:30 p.m. Sept. 28.

news.title: Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center to celebrate completion of Phase I of the Campus Master Plan with ribbon-cutting ceremony
news.summary_en: The Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center, based at the University of Kansas, invites the media to celebrate the completion of Phase I of its Campus Master Plan with a ribbon-cutting ceremony Oct. 2 at the campus near Yoder.

news.title: KU holds steady at No. 74 among publics in latest U.S. News & World Report rankings
news.summary_en: For the second consecutive year, the University of Kansas is ranked No. 74 among public universities in U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Colleges” rankings, released today.

news.title: KU Libraries to host KU alum, American Girl author Angela Cervantes for Hispanic Heritage Month
news.summary_en: Angela Cervantes, the Jayhawk behind American Girl’s 2026 Girl of the Year character, Raquel Reyes, will return to the University of Kansas on Oct. 17 for a free family event celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month.
